svg.title: 1418 Alder Street — Site Plan
svg.desc: Permit site plan of Lot 7, Block 3, a 7,200 square foot lot on Alder Street: existing 32 by 40 foot residence, proposed 26 by 24 foot detached ADU, driveway, walks, patio, fence, a 10 foot rear utility easement, setbacks from all four lot lines, utilities, and a site data table. Building coverage 26.4%, impervious surface 38.9%.
svg.text: Lot 7, Block 3 · 7,200 sf lot · proposed detached ADU · bearings and distances in feet
Driveway apron in the street right-of-way is not counted.
Measured square to each lot line from the nearest wall.
